evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%.

hazard.energy_source: gravity, potential energy due to height and momentum

risk.severity_justification: Potential for serious injury (fractures, concussion) due to fall from height.
risk.likelihood_justification: Walking with an object while navigating a construction site increases the risk of tripping.

immediate.description: Worker was walking while carrying an object, potentially obstructing their view and balance.
The walking surface may have been uneven or obstructed, contributing to the trip.

root_five_whys: Why did the worker trip? The worker was carrying an object.
Why was the worker carrying an object? The worker was transporting materials.
Why was the worker transporting materials? Materials were not stored in a designated area.
Why were materials not stored in a designated area? Lack of a clear material storage plan.
Why was there a lack of a clear material storage plan? Insufficient site organization and material handling procedures.

corrective_actions.description: Develop and implement a site-wide material storage plan to ensure materials are stored in designated areas.
Review and reinforce safe material handling procedures, emphasizing the importance of keeping hands free while walking.
Conduct a site assessment to identify and correct any uneven or obstructed walking surfaces.
Provide additional training to workers on hazard identification and safe work practices, including proper lifting and carrying techniques.

regulatory_note: This incident may meet the threshold for a provincial serious-incident or dangerous-occurrence notification. Verify the requirements with your provincial OHS regulator.
confidence_and_gaps: The worker's actions leading up to the fall were partially obscured by their orientation away from the camera. No physical contact with the hat was visible or audible in the video. The exact nature of the object the worker was carrying could not be determined. No video was available. The location of the incident on the site is unknown.
